description: Namur - Potentiel photovoltaïque par bâtiment is a dataset listed in OpenData de la commune de Namur open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Cartographie des bâtiments réalisée à partir de la modélisation 3D de Namur. En attributs, les valeurs totales, pour tous les pans de toits du bâtiment, de production annuelle d'électricité et l'équivalent en CO2 économisé. Coverage: Namur. The portal files it under Energie. Its keywords are Photovoltaïque, Bâtiment, électricité, panneau, Energie, Pavillon. The portal shows 62,540 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-05-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-namur-be-portal.
